verdict.rationale: Zapier natively supports the 'Webhooks by Zapier' trigger (documented as part of Platform CLI's webhook trigger support in zapier-docs-3, and the built-in Visual Builder path in zapier-docs-19/22) allowing a custom URL to receive HTTP POSTs and start a Zap run with the payload — this is a long-standing, widely used core Zapier capability. missing for 10: no explicit first-party doc snippet showing the raw webhook URL creation flow or payload-to-trigger-data mapping example, and no independent hands-on confirmation in this pack beyond general webhook-ease commentary in zapier-comm-1.
